events.title: Bent Creek Workday: Ingles Field
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA for a work day on Ingles Field Gap! No experience is necessary - our Pisgah SORBA Trail Crew Leaders will provide all tools, guidance, and instruction. Date: Friday, November 20 from 10:00AM - 2:00PM Trail Work Location: Ingles Field Gap Meetup Location: Ledford Parking Lot Work description: Clearing drains, tread work, and brushing TCL: Craig Ruhland Required items: Long pants, boots that cover your ankles, safety glasses (can be provided), gloves (can be provided), hardhat (bike helmets DO NOT count, but climbing helmets do, and helmets can be provided), snacks/lunch and water. All tools will be provided. Come out and give back to the trails!

events.title: 2026 Annual Meeting
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA for our Annual Meeting as we vote in our 2027 Board of Directors, share updates on our projects, programs, and plans for the year ahead. We will also be hosting a panel discussion about this History of Pisgah. Come on out to connect with the local trail community and learn how we’re working together to build and maintain better trails across Western North Carolina! No RSVP is required. Date: Monday, December 7th Time: 5:30pm - 7:30pm (panel will begin at 6:30pm) Location: The Mule at Devils Foot in Asheville
events.venue: 131 Sweeten Creek Rd, Asheville, NC 28803, USA
